title: Microsoft MultiMedia Keyboard Colors - Rare Wired Model KB-2025 - VTG Windows PC
descriptionText:
You're looking at a rare variant of the Microsoft MultiMedia Keyboard Colors, Model KB-2025. Unlike the more common KB-0225 model, this version is much harder to find and features the same iconic colorful multimedia keys, making it a great find for vintage computing fans and collectors alike.

Key Features:

Genuine Microsoft Model KB-2025 – uncommon and hard to find
Vibrant color-coded multimedia buttons (volume, play/pause, etc.)
Standard full-size layout – not ergonomic
Reliable wired connection via USB
Classic Windows keyboard – designed for Windows 98/2000/XP but works with newer systems too
Comfortable, tactile typing feel
Condition:

Pre-owned, fully tested and working
Keys are all functional and responsive
Shows some normal wear from use (see photos)
Clean and ready to plug in
Included:

Microsoft KB-2025 Keyboard (exact item pictured)
